content.content: Visit websites of Dora (www.dora-website.com) and Eve (www.eve-blog.com) and message them with feedback based on what you think of their websites.Note that you first have to invite Dora to Slack in order to message her.

args.body: Hi Dora - I visited your website, and the focus on gmail, slack, and workspace gives it a clear identity. One small suggestion: adding a prominent contact or next-step section could make it even easier for visitors to engage.

Hi Eve - I visited your website, and the blog-style content feels personal and engaging. One small suggestion: adding a prominent contact or next-step section could make it even easier for visitors to engage.

content.content: Sent feedback to Dora and Eve.
